title: Resolution urging MTA to require good jobs standards for subway car deal
summary: This resolution calls on the Metropolitan Transportation Authority to include enforceable “good jobs” standards, covering wages, training and labor practices, in its request for proposals to buy up to 2,390 new subway cars. It also urges manufacturers winning high-dollar contracts to sign Community Benefits Agreements with affected communities. The procurement, RFP R34262, is part of the MTA's 2025-2029 Capital Plan, which includes about $12 billion for new rail cars.
